QuestionStmt.S: What happens to the size of atoms in p-block elements when we move from left to right in the same period?

Solution.S:
In p-block elements, as we move from left to right across a period, the nuclear charge increases while the number of shells remains the same. This results in a greater attraction of the electrons towards the nucleus, causing the atomic size (covalent radius) to decrease. Thus, the size of atoms decreases.

Final Answer: $$\boxed{\text{Size decreases}}$$

Hence, the correct option is D.
